description: This Java class OrderSaveHandler is responsible for handling the save operation of Order objects within the OpenMRS system. It is an implementation of the SaveHandler interface specific to Order objects and is automatically invoked during the save process via AOP advice. The handler ensures that the Order has a patient associated with it, assigning one from the encounter if necessary.

classes.name: OrderSaveHandler
classes.description: Handles the saving process of Order objects, ensuring the patient is set if missing.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Ensures that the Order object has an associated patient by copying from the encounter if missing.
